title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (13,105 affected)

title: VERITRANS SPECIALTY VEHICLES, INC.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM (192 affected)

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: WINNEBAGO/EQUIPMENT: CERTIFICATION LABEL (59 affected)
summary: THE CERTIFICATION LABEL ON THESE VEHICLES HAS INCORRECT TIRE PRESSURE DATA. A TIRE PRESSURE RATING OF 110 PSI WAS LISTED FOR BOTH FRONT AND REAR TIRES. THE PROPER TIRE PRESSURE VALUES ARE 90 PSI FRONT AND 80 PSI REAR.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (3,500 affected)

THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.
